statement: The recorded payment destination is not safe or correct to release because the account holder does not match the employee and the change-date information is contradictory, so I will place the pay on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded payment destination is not safe or correct to release because the account holder does not match the employee and the change-date information is contradictory" names the specific defect rather than merely urging verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
